<issue>Issue Title: [BUG] Structured output is not properly propagated in the graph
Description:
### Checks
- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched [./issues](./issues?q=) and there are no duplicates of my issue
### Strands Version
1.21.0
### Python Version
3.12.11
### Operating System
Linux
### Installation Method
pip
### Steps to Reproduce
In scenarios where a node returns both `text` and `structured_output`
### Expected Behavior
Both `text` and `structured_output` should be forwarded to the next agent as input
### Actual Behavior
Only the text output is propagated
### Additional Context
_No response_
### Possible Solution
The relevant logic is here, where `str()` is called on `AgentResult`:
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/318573d0618c283f6f16ace1117d5e3d76279568/src/strands/multiagent/graph.py#L1002-L1005
In `AgentResult.__str__`, the `structured_output` is ignored whenever `text` is present:
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/4ba0b47b6322bc7a8b04763e1a4d8f402e4778db/src/strands/agent/agent_result.py#L37-L57
### Related Issues
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/pull/1290
</issue>

The attempt to directly search for the __str__ method in the agent_result.py file did not return any results. This likely means the method could be implemented differently, perhaps as a property or named differently, or it could be structured within a class that is not being found by searching for just the method name.

Given the issue description:

1. The __str__ method of the AgentResult class is relevant, specifically because it ignores the structured_output whenever text is present.
2. The str() call on AgentResult in graph.py also causes only the text to be forwarded while ignoring structured_output.
3. We need to inspect the AgentResult class, specifically around line 37-57 in agent_result.py as per the issue description.
4. It might be helpful first to search for the AgentResult class in the agent_result.py file, to get familiarity with the class definition and all relevant methods including __str__ (or equivalent).

- Search for the AgentResult class definition in agent_result.py
- After finding it, search for the __str__ method specifically inside this class
- Also consider searching graph.py around line 1002 for the code that is calling str() on AgentResult

2. where are bug locations:
Location 1: File: src/strands/agent/agent_result.py, Class: AgentResult, Method: __str__
- Intended behavior: The __str__ method should include both the text and structured_output in its string representation or provide a mechanism to propagate both values so that structured_output is not lost when str() is called. This change is necessary so that when AgentResult is converted to string, the structured_output is not ignored if text is present.

Location 2: File: src/strands/multiagent/graph.py, (method around line 1002 using str() on AgentResult)
- Intended behavior: The code that calls str() on AgentResult to get output for the next agent should be updated to propagate both text and structured_output (not just the string representation of text), preserving the structured output information for subsequent nodes in the graph.
